summary: Frontend-only visual redesign (Iteration 46 — Uber-inspired). All 23 targeted checks passed: Landing page renders new design with correct data-testids (page-landing, landing-hero, hero-search-form, hero-search-input, hero-search-submit, services-grid, landing-how-it-works, landing-trust, landing-marketplace, landing-provider-cta); all 8 service tiles (delivery/cleaning/moving/handyman/auto/pet_care/personal_care/digital_tech) present and navigate to /order/<slug>; services-all -> /services; marketplace-browse -> /marketplace; marketplace-sell -> /marketplace/new; provider-signup as guest -> /register?role=provider. NavBar is sticky+glass (backdrop-filter: saturate(1.8) blur(14px)). Role-siloed navs verified: guest (nav-services/marketplace/earn + login/register), customer (nav-customer only, no provider/admin), provider (nav-map + nav-provider, no customer/admin), admin (nav-admin only). Legacy redirects work: /stores, /restaurants, /rentals, /autos, /real-estate -> /services; /marketplaces -> /marketplace. Register page shows only Customer + Provider role cards (no retailer/restaurant). Regression routes /how-it-works, /marketplace, /order/cleaning, /admin render without JS pageerrors.

issues: Hero image loads correctly at 1440x900. Empty white space above hero fold is intentional but appears tall on shorter viewports.

critical_code_review_comments: Console shows repeated 'net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED' resource errors on /marketplace and other routes (likely external image CDNs / analytics beacons). Non-blocking but noisy — worth auditing image src hosts and analytics endpoints.
Google Maps warns Autocomplete is deprecated (as of March 1, 2025). Consider migrating to PlaceAutocompleteElement in a future iteration.
Landing.jsx imports MapPin, ShoppingBag but does not use them — dead imports.
Hero right-side image is hidden on <lg; consider a lightweight mobile alternative for visual balance.
